parameters.query:
-- The KPI row (see the kpi_last_7_days view in db/init.sql), the time-saved assumption,
-- and the approved bookings for the next 14 days.
SELECT k.*,
  (SELECT value::int FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'minutes_saved_per_request') AS minutes_per_request,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'resource', r.name_ar, 'item', b.item, 'production', b.production,
      'start_date', b.start_date, 'end_date', b.end_date, 'quantity', b.quantity)
      ORDER BY b.start_date), '[]'::json)
   FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN resources r ON r.code = b.resource_code
   WHERE b.end_date >= current_date AND b.start_date < current_date + $1::int) AS upcoming
FROM kpi_last_7_days k;
